name: vector_type
description: Returns the VectorType of a given column

name: sleep_ms
description: Sleeps for the specified number of milliseconds and returns NULL

name: index_key
description: Generate index keys from key column arguments. The path struct requires a 'table' field, optional 'catalog'/'schema' fields, and either an 'index' field naming a user-defined index, or a 'constraint' field ('primary', 'unique' or 'foreign') selecting a constraint index. A 'columns' list selects the constraint by its key columns; it is only required when the table has multiple constraints of the given type. Currently only supports ART indexes.
